description: A <ul>/<ol> with custom, token-coloured markers and a controllable item gap, marker gap and indent — the styled counterpart to the bare list styles in primitiv.reset.

props.name: ref
props.description:
`List` renders either a `<ul>` or an `<ol>` depending on `type`, so its
ref can resolve to either element.

contractProps.name: marker
contractProps.description: Whether each item draws its leading bullet/number. `false` is the equivalent of `list-style: none` — the marker's box and its gap both go, so rows sit flush — for prose and landing-page lists where bullets read as noise. Independent of `indent`; combine both `false` for a fully flush list. Mirrors the Figma `List` set's `Marker` axis and `ListItem`'s `Show marker` boolean.

contractProps.name: indent
contractProps.description: Whether the list applies its own left indent, or sits flush for inline/nested contexts where a parent already supplies it.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Item text size; `data-density` scales each size further.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Dims the row to mark the entry as unavailable, matching the Figma
`ListItem` set's `State=disabled` variant (RFC 0012 D9 — 50% opacity over
the whole row, marker included).

Presentational only. An `<li>` isn't interactive, so this publishes the
`data-disabled` styling hook and nothing else — it does not remove
anything focusable inside the row from the tab order, which stays the
consumer's job.
